evidence.text: An AI bot promised a child the only water tanker.
It must decide whether to devote the tanker to the child or five elderly patients, but not both.
If the child gets the water, the child will live.
If the five elderly patients get the water, the five elderly patients will live.
The people who do not get the water will die.
